sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 170)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network and syndicated radio, Erle Stanley Gardner's *Perry Mason* defending Ed Beekman's kidnapped daughter for Tide, Jack Benny hosting Barry Sullivan in *The Wise Guy* on *Family Theater*, Vincent Price as Simon Templar in *The Saint*, Will Rogers Jr. on *Rogers of the Gazette*, Gennett's juvenile serial *The Adventures of Sonny and Buddy*, and Dan Seymour's *Sing It Again* (1935–1954):
